source_row.stem: A client with metastatic cancer reports new back pain with progressive leg weakness and bowel/bladder changes. The nurse should suspect:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A simple muscle strain, since progressive leg weakness and bowel changes are thought to typically reflect local strain","B":"A normal finding that would not usually prompt urgent evaluation in a client with metastatic cancer","C":"An unrelated urinary tract infection, since bladder changes are thought to typically point to this simpler cause","D":"Spinal cord compression, an oncologic emergency requiring immediate evaluation to prevent permanent paralysis"}}
source_row.rationale: New back pain with progressive leg weakness and bowel/bladder dysfunction in a client with cancer suggests spinal cord compression, an oncologic emergency requiring immediate imaging and intervention to prevent permanent paralysis.
source_row.source_name: Oncologic Emergencies References — Spinal Cord Compression
source_row.source_detail: Recognition of Malignant Spinal Cord Compression
